facility_roles.quote: The Baryon Antibaryon Symmetry Experiment (BASE) at CERN compares the magnetic moments and charge-to-mass ratios of protons and antiprotons

intervals.label: antiproton runs at the Antiproton Decelerator
intervals.note: Start year is the first antiproton run named in the BASE charge-to-mass paper; BASE's approval and installation date is not stated in a source consulted. End: 31 August 2026 (LS3).
intervals.quote: participated in the 2014 antiproton run and contributed to the data collection

intervals.label: Long Shutdown 3 (no antiproton beam)
intervals.note: The Antimatter Factory (AD and ELENA) delivered its last beams on 31 August 2026 and "will progressively return to operation from 2028 onwards, with the different injectors and facilities restarting in stages" (CERN, 31 August 2026); no experiment-specific restart date is published, so the end is left open.
intervals.quote: CERN’s injector complex and Antimatter Factory took their final steps towards Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) this morning, as the last particle beams were extracted and the machines fell silent.

name: BASE
notes: BASE also operates apparatus at other sites (the BASE-STEP transportable trap, and BASE-Mainz for protons); only the CERN AD apparatus is placed here.

physics_goals.quote: The Baryon Antibaryon Symmetry Experiment (BASE) at CERN compares the magnetic moments and charge-to-mass ratios of protons and antiprotons to look for differences in that sector.
physics_goals.value: Compare the magnetic moments and charge-to-mass ratios of protons and antiprotons to look for differences in that sector

summary.plain: A CERN experiment that holds single antiprotons in electromagnetic traps and measures how they spin and circle in a magnetic field, to compare their magnetic moment and charge-to-mass ratio with those of the proton.
summary.technical: BASE (Baryon Antibaryon Symmetry Experiment, AD-8): multi-Penning-trap system (analysis, precision, cooling and reservoir traps) for proton/antiproton magnetic-moment and charge-to-mass-ratio comparisons; antiproton magnetic moment to 1.5 ppb (2017), q/m to 16 ppt (2022). At the AD since 2014.
